heading_script_line: Many Ways to Say “This Is My Idea.”
body_text: Every child has many ways of expressing what they think, feel and imagine. There is no single right way to create.

items.title: Art Atelier
items.text: A space to experiment with paint, colour, clay and open-ended materials.

items.title: Drama & Theatre
items.text: Imaginative and dramatic play where children act out stories and ideas.

items.title: Ideas Made Visible
items.text: A line may become a road, a block structure a house. Children’s work is displayed at eye level so they can revisit it with pride.
